subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 Skill Sharpener 1. Which number is it? Answer 2. What is the value of the underlined digit? Tick the correct box. a. 627 20 200 70 b. 869 8 80 800 c. 199 9 90 100 3. a. Which number is correctly written in expanded form? Tick the correct box. 612 600+20+2 600+10+2 60+20+2 3. b. Which number correctly shows the number in a 3-digit form? Tick the correct box. 900+0+2 920 922 209 902 8

exercises.label: 1. Which number is it?
items: base-ten block drawing: 1 hundred-flat, 4 ten-rods, 2 unit-cubes

exercises.label: 2.a. What is the value of the underlined digit in 627?
exercises.instruction_verbatim: What is the value of the underlined digit? Tick the correct box. a. 627 [boxes: 20, 200, 70]
exercises.answer_key: 20 (the underline sits under the tens digit '2').

exercises.label: 2.b. What is the value of the underlined digit in 869?
exercises.answer_key: 800 (the underline sits under the hundreds digit '8').

exercises.label: 2.c. What is the value of the underlined digit in 199?
exercises.answer_key: 9 (the underline sits under the ones-place '9', the final digit).

exercises.label: 3.a. Which number is correctly written in expanded form? (612)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Which number is correctly written in expanded form? Tick the correct box. 612 [600+20+2 / 600+10+2 / 60+20+2]

exercises.label: 3.b. Which number correctly shows the number in a 3-digit form? (900+0+2)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Which number correctly shows the number in a 3-digit form? Tick the correct box. 900+0+2 [920 / 922 / 209 / 902]

illustrations.description: Blue circular icon of a wrench and pencil crossed, next to the 'Skill Sharpener' heading.
illustrations.pedagogical_role: section icon for Skill Sharpener (independent practice)

illustrations.description: Q1 base-ten block drawing: 1 blue hundred-flat (10x10 grid), 4 orange ten-rods, and 2 red unit-cubes (stacked vertically), followed by an 'Answer' label and an empty blue-outlined answer box.
illustrations.pedagogical_role: counting/place-value exercise - student reads the blocks and writes the number

visual_layout_notes: Header 'Chapter 1 / Numberland Adventures: Up to 999'. 'Skill Sharpener' title with wrench icon. Q1 base-ten blocks + Answer box. Q2 a/b/c each show a bold 3-digit number with a red underline beneath one digit, plus three tickbox options with printed values below each box. Q3a shows '612' in blue bold with three bordered option pills for expanded form. Q3b shows '900+0+2' in blue bold with four bordered option pills for 3-digit form. Footer page number '8' centered at bottom, confirming printed page 8 = pdf 13 - 5.
